title: The Pulse #13 Marvel 2006 1st Appearance Danielle Cage Jessica Jones Luke Cage
conditionDescription: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Pulse #13 (March 2006), Marvel Comics - "Fear, Part 3." First appearance of Danielle Cage, daughter of Jessica Jones and Luke Cage. Written by Brian Michael Bendis, art by Michael Gaydos; cover by Mike Mayhew. Rated T+. Direct edition, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: The Flash Complete Series DVD ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
